versions.subject: fix: update logic
versions.detection:
selection_metadata:
    - Image|endswith: '\powershell.exe'
    - Description: 'Windows PowerShell'
    - Product: 'PowerShell Core 6'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'bxor'
        - '-join '
        - '-join'''
        - '-join"'
        - '-join`'
        - 'char'
filter_amazon:
    ParentImage: 'C:\Program Files\Amazon\SSM\ssm-document-worker.exe'
filter_powershell_script:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        # Example: https://github.com/SigmaHQ/sigma/pull/3717#issue-1455440560
        - 'function Convert-GuidToCompressedGuid'
        - 'ValueFromPipelineByPropertyName'
condition: all of selection_* and not 1 of filter_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\powershell.exe" OR Description="Windows PowerShell" OR Product="PowerShell Core 6" CommandLine IN ("*bxor*", "*-join *", "*-join'*", "*-join\"*", "*-join`*", "*char*") NOT (ParentImage="C:\\Program Files\\Amazon\\SSM\\ssm-document-worker.exe" OR (CommandLine="*function Convert-GuidToCompressedGuid*" CommandLine="*ValueFromPipelineByPropertyName*"))

versions.subject: fix: add more filters and update image field
versions.detection:
selection_metadata:
    - Image|endswith:
        - '\powershell.exe'
        - '\pwsh.exe'
    - OriginalFileName:
        - 'PowerShell.EXE'
        - 'pwsh.dll'
    - Description: 'Windows PowerShell'
    - Product: 'PowerShell Core 6'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'bxor'
        - '-join '
        - '-join'''
        - '-join"'
        - '-join`'
        - 'char'
filter_amazon:
    ParentImage: 'C:\Program Files\Amazon\SSM\ssm-document-worker.exe'
filter_powershell_script:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        # Script part of Amazon SSM worker (But the parent is empty - see example linked below)
        # Example: https://github.com/SigmaHQ/sigma/pull/3717#issue-1455440560
        - 'function Convert-GuidToCompressedGuid'
        - 'ValueFromPipelineByPropertyName'
        - '::ParseExact('
        - 'KB[000000-999999]'
condition: all of selection_* and not 1 of filter_*
versions.spl: Image IN ("*\\powershell.exe", "*\\pwsh.exe") OR OriginalFileName IN ("PowerShell.EXE", "pwsh.dll") OR Description="Windows PowerShell" OR Product="PowerShell Core 6" CommandLine IN ("*bxor*", "*-join *", "*-join'*", "*-join\"*", "*-join`*", "*char*") NOT (ParentImage="C:\\Program Files\\Amazon\\SSM\\ssm-document-worker.exe" OR (CommandLine="*function Convert-GuidToCompressedGuid*" CommandLine="*ValueFromPipelineByPropertyName*" CommandLine="*::ParseExact(*" CommandLine="*KB[000000-999999]*"))
